data.name: DiagonalImbalance_Description
data.value: Detects diagonal bid/ask imbalances in the footprint and draws stacked imbalances as zones.

data.name: ImbalanceRatio_Description
data.value: Minimum ratio between the dominant side and the diagonal passive side, e.g. 3 = 300%.

data.name: MinDominantVolume_Description
data.value: Minimum volume on the dominant side for a level to count as an imbalance.

data.name: MinVolumeDifference_Description
data.value: Minimum difference between the dominant side and the diagonal passive side. 0 disables the filter.

data.name: IgnoreZeroLevels_Description
data.value: When enabled, a level whose diagonal passive side has no volume is never an imbalance. When disabled, it counts as an infinite ratio and only the minimum dominant volume applies.

data.name: RowTicks_Description
data.value: Number of price levels merged into one row before comparing, like a footprint with grouped rows. Rows are aligned to multiples of this size.

data.name: MinStackedLevels_Description
data.value: Minimum number of consecutive price levels with an imbalance on the same side to form a stacked imbalance.

data.name: Days_Description
data.value: Number of sessions, counting the current one, in which imbalances are evaluated. 0 = the whole chart.

data.name: UseSessionFilter_Description
data.value: Only evaluate bars that open inside the session time range (chart time zone). Zones created inside the session keep extending and can break outside it.

data.name: SessionStart_Description
data.value: Start of the session time range (inclusive). A start later than the end spans midnight.

data.name: SessionEnd_Description
data.value: End of the session time range (exclusive).

data.name: BreakMode_Description
data.value: Touch: price trades into the zone. Trade through: price trades beyond its far edge (below a buy zone, above a sell zone). Close beyond: a bar closes beyond its far edge.

data.name: MaxZoneAgeBars_Description
data.value: A zone that has not been broken after this many bars stops extending. 0 = no limit.

data.name: MaxActiveZones_Description
data.value: When a new zone would exceed this number of active zones, the oldest active zone stops extending. 0 = no limit.

data.name: ShowMarks_Description
data.value: Highlights every level with a diagonal imbalance.

data.name: MarksLayout_Description
data.value: Footprint halves: sell marks on the left (Bid) half and buy marks on the right (Ask) half. Full bar: marks use the whole bar width. Auto: halves when the bar is wide enough, full bar otherwise.

data.name: BuyColor_Description
data.value: Color of buy imbalances (Ask against the Bid one tick below).

data.name: SellColor_Description
data.value: Color of sell imbalances (Bid against the Ask one tick above).

data.name: ShowZones_Description
data.value: Draws each stacked imbalance as a zone that extends to the right until it is broken (see Zone break rule).

data.name: BuyZoneColor_Description
data.value: Fill color of zones from stacked buy imbalances.

data.name: SellZoneColor_Description
data.value: Fill color of zones from stacked sell imbalances.

data.name: ZoneBorderWidth_Description
data.value: Width of the zone outline, drawn in the zone color without transparency. 0 = no outline.

data.name: ShowZoneLabels_Description
data.value: Writes the number of stacked levels (for example x4) at the start of each zone.

data.name: LabelFontSize_Description
data.value: Font size of the zone labels.

data.name: DetailedLog_Description
data.value: Writes every imbalance of the last 20 bars after a recalculation, and of every bar that closes afterwards, to the ATAS log. For checking the indicator against the footprint.

data.name: AlertOnNewZone_Description
data.value: Alert when a bar closes with a stacked imbalance and a new zone is created.

data.name: AlertOnRetest_Description
data.value: Alert when price moves from outside an active zone into it.

data.name: AlertFile_Description
data.value: Sound file used by the alerts.

data.name: AlertCooldownSeconds_Description
data.value: Minimum time between two retest alerts of the same zone.

data.name: Location_Description
data.value: Only keeps the imbalances in this part of the bar; stacks and zones are built from the kept imbalances. At the high: the row reaches the High (only buy imbalances can). At the low: the row reaches the Low (only sell imbalances can). Body, upper wick and lower wick are separated by the Open and Close.

data.name: EdgeTicks_Description
data.value: With At the high / At the low: also keeps the rows that end up to this number of ticks from the High or the Low. 0 = only the row that contains it.
